hero.name: DAVID LÓPEZ GIRALDO
hero.bio: Product Manager & UX Leader specialized in B2B and B2G digital products. With over 8 years of experience, I lead multidisciplinary squads applying agile methodologies and generative AI to build solutions that transform public and business management. My expertise combines strategic product vision, user-centered design, and technology to deliver digital experiences that create real impact.

about.title: About Me
about.intro1: Professional with a background in Business Administration and Systems Analysis and Development, specialized in building and managing digital products in B2B, B2G, and iGaming environments.
about.intro2: With experience in leading multidisciplinary squads and applying agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), I work at the intersection of product, design, and technology, using generative AI to optimize discovery processes, documentation, and automation.

projects.title: RECENT PROJECTS.
projects.intro: I've been involved in a variety of projects recently, creating stories, designing interfaces, and developing digital experiences. My recent work reflects my commitment to helping clients achieve their goals.
